title: Forecast-revision underreaction at close minus 24 hours
claim: At market close minus 24 hours, a model using market-implied probability plus the most recent point-in-time NWS forecast revision improves Brier score over market-implied probability alone for eligible single-sided daily high and low temperature threshold markets at CHI, DEN, LAX, and NYC.
mechanism: Weather-market prices may adjust incompletely or slowly to newly arriving forecast revisions because of limited attention and thin participation.
falsification: If the revision-augmented model does not improve untouched test Brier under the frozen success rule, H0020 is NOT SUPPORTED and final.

availability.issue_time_as_availability: FORBIDDEN (measured ingestion delay p50 46m, p90 107m, p99 ~9.6h)
availability.market_evidence: latest candlestick close at or before decision time; production environment only

include: point-in-time market evidence at or before decision time
valid frozen revision construction (F_latest and F_prev per revision_spec)

exclude_with_reason_codes.no_forecast_available_at_decision: no forecast row with observed_at <= decision
exclude_with_reason_codes.latest_forecast_stale: latest observed_at older than decision minus 30h
exclude_with_reason_codes.no_market_evidence_at_decision: no candle at or before decision time

revision_spec.f_latest: greatest issue_time among rows with observed_at <= decision_time; observed_at >= decision_time - 30h
revision_spec.f_prev: greatest issue_time among rows with observed_at <= decision_time and issue_time <= issue_time(F_latest) - 60min and issue_time >= issue_time(F_latest) - 30h
revision_spec.tie_break: greatest (issue_time, observed_at, id) — corrected same-issue rows resolve to latest observed_at; exact ties to max(id); earlier rows retained for provenance
revision_spec.missing_prior: exclude with reason no_eligible_prior_forecast; never impute zero
revision_spec.directional_feature: rev_dir = revision_24h * threshold_side_sign; threshold_side_sign = +1 when YES pays above the threshold, -1 when YES pays below

model_spec.benchmark_M1: latest eligible market-implied probability at decision time, clipped to [0.02, 0.98]
model_spec.model_MR: L2 logistic regression (numpy IRLS, experiments/baseline.fit_logistic) on exactly [logit(market_probability), rev_dir]
forbidden: calibration stage beyond fitted intercept and coefficients
model_spec.missing_data: exclude with recorded reason; no imputation
model_spec.primary_comparison: Brier(MR) - Brier(M1) on the single untouched test window, (station, variable, target_date)-grouped bootstrap, 2000 resamples, 95% CI, seed 20260909; lower is better; exactly one primary comparison

grouping_unit: event_group = (station, variable, target_date); no group may cross train/validation/test

test_extension_rule.on_gates_unmet_at_absolute_end: status DEFERRED_INSUFFICIENT_DATA; do not run the final test; do not change the hypothesis; no replacement window post hoc
test_extension_rule.note: extensions re-evaluate readiness counts only; encoded before any test access

readiness_gates.note: readiness inspects counts and integrity only; it must not compute predictive performance

success_rule.SUPPORTED: readiness gates passed before test execution AND mean Brier(MR)-Brier(M1) < 0 AND 95% grouped-bootstrap CI entirely below 0 AND no station has a positive mean Brier difference
success_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: non-negative point estimate OR CI touches/crosses zero OR any station reverses the sign criterion; final — no rerun, no changed window, no feature addition, no threshold adjustment, no reinterpretation as partial support
success_rule.INVALID: leakage OR hash mismatch OR test access before readiness OR issue_time used as availability OR split-integrity failure OR registered design not reproducible
success_rule.on_supported: authorizes only a separate untouched replication registration; does not authorize paper or live trading

commands.readiness: uv run kalshi-weather experiment readiness h0020
commands.final_run_single_shot: uv run kalshi-weather experiment run h0020 --out docs/research/experiments/EXP-FUTURE-H0020/
commands.note: h0020 readiness/runner support is to be implemented (counts-only readiness first) before the validation window closes; the single-run guard must refuse a second test execution

artifacts.manifest: immutable manifest per dataset/manifest.py: git SHA, DB revision, dataset manifest hash, dependency lock hash (uv.lock sha256), config hash, registration hash, ledger sequence + record hash, stdout/stderr capture, sha256 of every output artifact
artifacts.ledger: docs/research/ledger.jsonl (native record follows the two marked backfills)
